svg.title: UML Class / Component View - Backend functional modules and the models they use

g.text: UML Class / Component View - Backend functional modules and the models they use
Companion to class-diagram.puml. The backend is plain CommonJS modules, not classes;
«module» boxes show real require() dependencies only. Model boxes are the
Mongoose models from class-diagram.puml (attributes omitted here).
verifies the accessToken cookie with jsonwebtoken (JWT_SEC)
and loads User; does not use helpers
